title: Les déclinaisons
intro: Six variantes par marque, générées à partir du master : même produit, même lumière, seules les couleurs changent.

jobs.label: Tanchet
jobs.prompt:
The FIRST reference image is the MASTER product photo: keep EXACTLY the same product, construction, proportions, board, camera angle, framing, light, background and patch. Change ONLY the colors or print of the canvas panel and of the straps as specified. The second image is the logo on the patch, unchanged.

NEW COLORWAY: panel mandarine #F26A2E, straps pistachio #B5D99C. Everything else identical to the master. No text.
